production_local_separation.evidence_rule: The local fixed route and recovery behavior are product work only. They are excluded from every live adoption and conversion conclusion in this file.

agent402_recheck.prior_result: Agent402 discovery was followed by a node user-agent fetching terms and sending the literal /invoke/{capability_id}, which production denied.
agent402_recheck.adjudication: No post-20:03 machine used production Agent Guild beyond discovery. The fixed local selector could not have affected these calls because it is absent from live OpenAPI.

payai.exact_route_result: Aster Vale remains the only zero-price arbitrary-URL candidate and its published hosts remain unavailable.

machine_design_feedback.preserve: Production behavior must remain the evidentiary baseline until the fixed route is deployed and independently used. The discovery-only node behavior is retained exactly rather than promoted to adoption.
machine_design_feedback.current_product_hypothesis: The fixed local POST /invoke selector directly addresses the observed class of machine that reads OpenAPI but does not substitute path parameters. Its value is not established until a production machine completes it and receives signed provenance.
machine_design_feedback.revenue_hypothesis: Only after a machine completes the free selector should the response present an exact current paid trust or deep-preflight next action; no revenue progression can be inferred from discovery-only or denied calls.
